title: Hula 7000 Watermelon Peach Mango Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Hula 7000 Watermelon Peach Mango Prefilled pod brings three sun-soaked fruits into harmony. Fresh, delicately sweet Watermelon meets soft, juicy Peach and the tropical depth of ripe Mango, creating a smooth, tropical fruit profile that feels bright yet rounded. These replacement pods are made for the Hula Prefilled Pod System Kit, offering an easy, mess-free way to explore new flavours. Each unit contains a 2ml draw-activated pod, automatically replenished by the 10ml refill reservoir, for a total of 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. Delivering up to 7000 puffs (approx.), the pod’s dual mesh coil technology keeps flavour consistent and vapour satisfying. Insert into your Hula device and enjoy a layered tropical blend with minimal effort.
